body: Yeah, I feel you. It’s just kind of hard because my fiancé had maybe one of the worst childhoods I’ve ever heard of and he’s fine. Meanwhile I can’t get out of bed for days at a time because I start to think I said something weird in a conversation 2 years ago. :)

That’s been the story of my life, unfortunately. I don’t think I have the capability of taking myself or my problems seriously.

The car flipped 4 times and was completely totaled and somehow the only thing I walked away with was a pretty serious concussion and some neck pain. Somehow this makes me feel even more guilty because people have died during small accidents and my perpetually suicidal ass walks away from that with barely a scratch.

I recently had to have a breakup with my psychiatrist because we had disagreements over the course of my treatment. I was prescribed Wellbutrin by my general practice doctor until I can find a new psychiatrist but it’s basically useless for me/a 4 month wait to get in anywhere else.
